verses.original: כִּ֤י יֵ֣שׁ לַכֶּ֣סֶף מוֹצָ֑א וּ֝מָק֗וֹם לַזָּהָ֥ב יָזֹֽקּוּ׃
verses.transliteration: kî yêš lak·ke·sep̄ mō·w·ṣā ū·mā·qō·wm laz·zā·hāḇ yā·zōq·qū
verses.literal: Surely there is a mine for silver and a place where gold is refined

verses.original: בַּ֭רְזֶל מֵעָפָ֣ר יֻקָּ֑ח וְ֝אֶ֗בֶן יָצ֥וּק נְחוּשָֽׁה׃
verses.transliteration: bar·zel mê·‘ā·p̄ār yuq·qāḥ wə·’e·ḇen yā·ṣūq nə·ḥū·šāh
verses.literal: Iron is taken from the earth and copper is smelted from ore

verses.original: קֵ֤ץ׀ שָׂ֤ם לַחֹ֗שֶׁךְ וּֽלְכָל־ תַּ֭כְלִית ה֣וּא חוֹקֵ֑ר אֶ֖בֶן אֹ֣פֶל וְצַלְמָֽוֶת׃
verses.transliteration: qêṣ śām la·ḥō·šeḵ ū·lə·ḵāl- taḵ·lîṯ hū ḥō·w·qêr ’e·ḇen ’ō·p̄el wə·ṣal·mā·weṯ
verses.literal: Man puts an end to the darkness he probes the farthest recesses . . . for ore in deepest darkness . . .

verses.original: פָּ֤רַץ נַ֨חַל׀ מֵֽעִם־ גָּ֗ר הַֽנִּשְׁכָּחִ֥ים מִנִּי־ רָ֑גֶל דַּ֖לּוּ מֵאֱנ֣וֹשׁ נָֽעוּ׃
verses.transliteration: pā·raṣ na·ḥal mê·‘im- gār han·niš·kā·ḥîm min·nî- rā·ḡel dal·lū mê·’ĕ·nō·wōš nā·‘ū
verses.literal: Far from . . . human habitation he cuts a shaft in places forgotten by the foot of man Far from men he dangles and sways

verses.original: אֶ֗רֶץ מִמֶּ֥נָּה יֵֽצֵא־ לָ֑חֶם וְ֝תַחְתֶּ֗יהָ נֶהְפַּ֥ךְ כְּמוֹ־ אֵֽשׁ׃
verses.transliteration: ’e·reṣ mim·men·nāh yê·ṣê- lā·ḥem wə·ṯaḥ·te·hā neh·paḵ kə·mōw- ’êš
verses.literal: Food may come from the earth but from below it is transformed as by fire

verses.original: מְקוֹם־ סַפִּ֥יר אֲבָנֶ֑יהָ וְעַפְרֹ֖ת זָהָ֣ב לֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: mə·qō·wm- sap·pîr ’ă·ḇā·ne·hā wə·‘ap̄·rōṯ zā·hāḇ lōw
verses.literal: Its rocks are the source of sapphires containing flecks of gold

verses.original: נָ֭תִיב לֹֽא־ יְדָ֣עוֹ עָ֑יִט וְלֹ֥א שְׁ֝זָפַ֗תּוּ עֵ֣ין אַיָּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: nā·ṯîḇ lō- yə·ḏā·‘ōw ‘ā·yiṭ wə·lō šə·zā·p̲at·tû ‘ên ’ay·yāh
verses.literal: No bird of prey knows that path no falcon’s eye has seen it

verses.original: לֹֽא־ הִדְרִיכֻ֥הוּ בְנֵי־ שָׁ֑חַץ לֹֽא־ עָדָ֖ה עָלָ֣יו שָֽׁחַל׃
verses.transliteration: lō- hiḏ·rî·ḵu·hū ḇə·nê- šā·ḥaṣ lō- ‘ā·ḏāh ‘ā·lāw šā·ḥal
verses.literal: Proud beasts . . . have never trodden it no lion has ever prowled over it

verses.original: בַּֽ֭חַלָּמִישׁ שָׁלַ֣ח יָד֑וֹ הָפַ֖ךְ מִשֹּׁ֣רֶשׁ הָרִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: ba·ḥal·lā·mîš šā·laḥ yā·ḏōw hā·p̄aḵ miš·šō·reš hā·rîm
verses.literal: The miner strikes . . . the flint he overturns mountains at their base

verses.original: בַּ֭צּוּרוֹת יְאֹרִ֣ים בִּקֵּ֑עַ וְכָל־ יְ֝קָ֗ר רָאֲתָ֥ה עֵינֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: baṣ·ṣū·rō·wṯ yə·’ō·rîm biq·qê·a‘ wə·ḵāl yə·qār rā·’ă·ṯāh ‘ê·nōw
verses.literal: He hews out channels in the rocks and his eyes spot every treasure

verses.original: מִ֭בְּכִי נְהָר֣וֹת חִבֵּ֑שׁ וְ֝תַעֲלֻמָ֗הּ יֹ֣צִא אֽוֹר׃פ
verses.transliteration: mib·bə·ḵî nə·hā·rō·wṯ ḥib·bêš wə·ṯa·ʿă·lu·må̄h yō·ṣi ’ō·wr
verses.literal: He stops up the sources of the streams to bring what is hidden to light

verses.original: וְֽ֭הַחָכְמָה מֵאַ֣יִן תִּמָּצֵ֑א וְאֵ֥י זֶ֝ה מְק֣וֹם בִּינָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ha·ḥā·ḵə·māh mê·’a·yin tim·mā·ṣê wə·’ê zeh mə·qō·wm bî·nāh
verses.literal: But where can wisdom be found and where does understanding . . . dwell

verses.original: לֹא־ יָדַ֣ע אֱנ֣וֹשׁ עֶרְכָּ֑הּ וְלֹ֥א תִ֝מָּצֵ֗א בְּאֶ֣רֶץ הַֽחַיִּֽים׃
verses.transliteration: lō- yā·ḏa‘ ’ĕ·nō·wōš ‘er·kāh wə·lō ṯim·mā·ṣê bə·’e·reṣ ha·ḥay·yîm
verses.literal: No man can know its value nor is it found in the land of the living

verses.original: תְּה֣וֹם אָ֭מַר לֹ֣א בִי־ הִ֑יא וְיָ֥ם אָ֝מַ֗ר אֵ֣ין עִמָּדִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: tə·hō·wm ’ā·mar lō ḇî- hî wə·yām ’ā·mar ’ên ‘im·mā·ḏî
verses.literal: The ocean depths say It is not in me while the sea declares It is not with me

verses.original: לֹא־ יֻתַּ֣ן סְג֣וֹר תַּחְתֶּ֑יהָ וְלֹ֥א יִ֝שָּׁקֵ֗ל כֶּ֣סֶף מְחִירָֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: lō- yut·tan sə·ḡō·wr taḥ·te·hā wə·lō yiš·šā·qêl ke·sep̄ mə·ḥî·rāh
verses.literal: It cannot be bought with gold nor can its price be weighed out in silver

verses.original: לֹֽא־ תְ֭סֻלֶּה בְּכֶ֣תֶם אוֹפִ֑יר בְּשֹׁ֖הַם יָקָ֣ר וְסַפִּֽיר׃
verses.transliteration: lō- ṯə·sul·leh bə·ḵe·ṯem ’ō·w·p̄îr bə·šō·ham yā·qār wə·sap·pîr
verses.literal: It cannot be valued in the gold of Ophir in precious onyx or sapphire

verses.original: לֹא־ יַעַרְכֶ֣נָּה זָ֭הָב וּזְכוֹכִ֑ית וּתְמ֖וּרָתָ֣הּ כְּלִי־ פָֽז׃
verses.transliteration: lō- ya·‘ar·ḵen·nāh zā·hāḇ ū·zə·ḵō·w·ḵîṯ ū·ṯə·mū·rā·ṯāh kə·lî- p̄āz
verses.literal: Neither gold nor crystal can compare to it nor jewels of fine gold be exchanged for it

verses.original: רָאמ֣וֹת וְ֭גָבִישׁ לֹ֣א יִזָּכֵ֑ר וּמֶ֥שֶׁךְ חָ֝כְמָ֗ה מִפְּנִינִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: rā·mō·wṯ wə·ḡā·ḇîš lō yiz·zā·ḵêr ū·me·šeḵ ḥāḵ·māh mip·pə·nî·nîm
verses.literal: Coral and quartz are unworthy of mention the price of wisdom is beyond rubies

verses.original: לֹֽא־ יַ֭עַרְכֶנָּה פִּטְדַת־ כּ֑וּשׁ בְּכֶ֥תֶם טָ֝ה֗וֹר לֹ֣א תְסֻלֶּֽה׃פ
verses.transliteration: lō- ya·‘ar·ḵen·nāh piṭ·ḏaṯ- kūš bə·ḵe·ṯem ṭā·hō·wr lō ṯə·sul·leh
verses.literal: Topaz from Cush cannot compare to it nor can it be valued in pure gold

verses.original: וְֽ֭הַחָכְמָה מֵאַ֣יִן תָּב֑וֹא וְאֵ֥י זֶ֝֗ה מְק֣וֹם בִּינָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ha·ḥā·ḵə·māh mê·’a·yin tā·ḇō·w wə·’ê zeh mə·qō·wm bî·nāh
verses.literal: From where then, does wisdom come and where . . . does understanding dwell

verses.original: וְֽ֭נֶעֶלְמָה מֵעֵינֵ֣י כָל־ חָ֑י וּמֵע֖וֹף הַשָּׁמַ֣יִם נִסְתָּֽרָה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ne·‘el·māh mê·‘ê·nê ḵāl ḥāy ū·mê·‘ō·wp̄ haš·šā·ma·yim nis·tā·rāh
verses.literal: It is hidden from the eyes of every living thing and concealed from the birds of the air

verses.original: אֲבַדּ֣וֹן וָ֭מָוֶת אָ֣מְר֑וּ בְּ֝אָזְנֵ֗ינוּ שָׁמַ֥עְנוּ שִׁמְעָֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: ’ă·ḇad·dō·wn wā·mā·weṯ ’ā·mə·rū bə·’ā·zə·nê·nū šā·ma‘·nū šim·‘āh
verses.literal: Abaddon and Death say We have heard a rumor about it

verses.original: אֱ֭לֹהִים הֵבִ֣ין דַּרְכָּ֑הּ וְ֝ה֗וּא יָדַ֥ע אֶת־ מְקוֹמָֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: ’ĕ·lō·hîm hê·ḇîn dar·kāh wə·hū yā·ḏa‘ ’eṯ- mə·qō·w·māh
verses.literal: But God understands its way and He knows its place

verses.original: כִּי־ ה֭וּא לִקְצוֹת־ הָאָ֣רֶץ יַבִּ֑יט תַּ֖חַת כָּל־ הַשָּׁמַ֣יִם יִרְאֶֽה׃
verses.transliteration: kî- hū liq·ṣō·wṯ- hā·’ā·reṣ yab·bîṭ ta·ḥaṯ kāl- haš·šā·ma·yim yir·’eh
verses.literal: For He looks to the ends of the earth and sees everything under the heavens

verses.original: לַעֲשׂ֣וֹת לָר֣וּחַ מִשְׁקָ֑ל וּ֝מַ֗יִם תִּכֵּ֥ן בְּמִדָּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: la·‘ă·śō·wṯ lā·rū·aḥ miš·qāl ū·ma·yim tik·kên bə·mid·dāh
verses.literal: When God fixed the weight of the wind and measured out the waters

verses.original: בַּעֲשֹׂת֣וֹ לַמָּטָ֣ר חֹ֑ק וְ֝דֶ֗רֶךְ לַחֲזִ֥יז קֹלֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: ba·ʿă·śō·ṯō lam·mā·ṭār ḥōq wə·ḏe·reḵ la·ḥă·zîz qō·lō·wṯ
verses.literal: when He set a limit for the rain and a path for the thunderbolt . . .

verses.original: אָ֣ז רָ֭אָהּ וַֽיְסַפְּרָ֑הּ הֱ֝כִינָ֗הּ וְגַם־ חֲקָרָֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: ’āz rā·’āh way·sap·pə·rāh hĕ·ḵî·nāh wə·ḡam- ḥă·qā·rāh
verses.literal: then He looked at wisdom and appraised it He established it . . . and searched it out

verses.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר׀ לָֽאָדָ֗ם הֵ֤ן יִרְאַ֣ת אֲ֭דֹנָי הִ֣יא חָכְמָ֑ה וְס֖וּר מֵרָ֣ע בִּינָֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer lā·’ā·ḏām hên yir·’aṯ ’ă·ḏō·nāy hî ḥāḵ·māh wə·sūr mê·rā‘ bî·nāh
verses.literal: And He said to man Behold the fear of the Lord that is wisdom and to turn away from evil is understanding
